page: Microsoft Azure E32ps_v6 is an ARM-based virtual machine belonging to the Epsv6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores powered by the Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor architecture operating at 3.4 GHz. The CPU configuration includes a 64 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 128 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data highlights strong multi-core and memory subsystem performance. The server achieves a top-tier rating in memory bandwidth, with read-only large block speeds of 436.06 GB/sec and write large block speeds of 184.19 GB/sec. Multi-core performance is strong, as evidenced by a stress-ng multi-core score of 66283.59 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 19664.0. Database operations are highly efficient, scoring in the top tier on PassMark database tests with 37163.36. Conversely, single-core performance and large-model LLM prompt processing represent relative performance tradeoffs.

Given its high memory density of 8.0 GB per core and top-tier memory bandwidth, the E32ps_v6 offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads without the overhead of x86 translation or hyperthreading. The dedicated ARM cores deliver predictable execution. This server is best suited for memory-intensive applications, database operations, static web serving, and multi-threaded data decompression tasks.
